Xiaoqiu (Shelly)
Yang

Ph.D. student in Bioengineering

Robert J. Levy Laboratory · University of Pennsylvania

I study how heart valve cells sense mechanical forces and how those signals contribute to valve disease.

My research examines PIEZO1, serotonin signaling, and extracellular matrix remodeling in mitral regurgitation. I use human valve cell models to connect changes in the mechanical environment with cellular responses.

Research interests

  • Cardiovascular mechanobiology
  • Serotonin signaling
  • Matrix remodeling

Latest publication

September 2026

Mechanosensing in mitral valve disease

Our paper in Cardiovascular Research examines how PIEZO1 and PIEZO2 connect mechanical cues with serotonin signaling and collagen synthesis in mitral valve cells.
